paths.description: Public root/login landing: represents the unauthenticated entry and marketing surface.
Primary /my/index action: tests whether an unauthenticated visitor can start/sign in.
Representative unknown route: tests HTTP/network recovery messaging.
Authenticated kitchen/game, shop, account, and purchase archetypes were not covered because credentials were not provided and the public primary route loops to the landing.

Network weight, redirects, blocking candidates, and hygiene
Metadata, CSS feature, semantics, focus, and target probe
Primary route loops to same landing

findings.summary: The page ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is visually identical to the light capture, and the computed root color-scheme is “normal”.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() to retint text, surfaces, and browser UI.

findings.summary: The page does not visibly adapt to increased-contrast preferences.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast: more screenshot is unchanged, while Lighthouse independently finds a 2.45:1 text contrast failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Add high-contrast and forced-colors styles, preserving visible text, controls, and focus indicators.

findings.summary: Navigation is an abrupt full-document swap with no transition treatment.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition rules; the primary action performs a document navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions with a reduced-motion fallback for meaningful navigation changes.

findings.summary: Fixed decorative framing dominates the layout and leaves substantial unused space on narrow screens.
findings.evidence: At 360×800 the 980 CSS-pixel desktop canvas is scaled down to 0.367 and most of the viewport below the 320px content column is empty.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace fixed desktop framing with a fluid, content-led layout that uses the available viewport.

findings.summary: The landing page does not genuinely adapt to a narrow viewport.
findings.evidence: The 360×800 capture renders a 980px layout scaled to 36.7%; layout evidence reports no viewport meta on the desktop variant, and Lighthouse finds user-scalable=no on the mobile variant.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve one responsive layout with width=device-width, allow zoom, and use fluid/intrinsic sizing instead of a fixed 980px canvas.

findings.summary: Components rely on legacy page-level variants rather than adapting to their container.
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS inspection found no container queries; narrow evidence shows the desktop composition merely scaled down.
findings.suggestedFix: Refactor reusable sections around container-type and @container rules, with intrinsic fallback layout.

findings.summary: Several interactive targets are too small for comfortable touch use.
findings.evidence: The focus/target probe measured footer links at only 14 CSS px high and a navigation link at 24px, below common 24/44px target guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive hit areas, preserve visible :focus-visible outlines, and avoid hover-only affordances.

findings.summary: The primary “start Mogg” action does not advance the unauthenticated user.
findings.evidence: Navigating directly to /my/index returns to the same /session/index login landing with no form or next step.
findings.suggestedFix: Route the primary CTA to a working, clearly labelled authentication/onboarding step and preserve a recoverable error if authentication is unavailable.

findings.summary: The failed primary action gives no visible status or recovery path.
findings.evidence: After /my/index loops back, the page remains visually unchanged and provides no error, retry, or explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Detect the authentication loop and show an actionable error with retry, help, and an alternate sign-in path.

findings.summary: The landing page loads well outside the good LCP range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 5.7s and LCP 6.5s (performance 0.62); the independent trace measured LCP 4.61s.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redirect and render-blocking delay, prioritize the LCP image, and reduce server response time to bring LCP below 2.5s.

findings.summary: A long redirect and render-blocking chain delays the first content.
findings.evidence: HAR records four document redirects, including an HTTPS→HTTP→HTTPS hop, five parser-blocking stylesheets, and classic scripts without async/defer; Lighthouse reports a 2.97s critical chain.
findings.suggestedFix: Redirect once directly to HTTPS, inline or trim critical CSS, defer noncritical styles/scripts, and prioritize the LCP image.

findings.summary: Legacy CSS and JavaScript dominate a simple landing page.
findings.evidence: The page transfers a 242,686-byte common stylesheet and jQuery 1.7 (33,915 bytes) for a mostly static 320px landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove obsolete SWF-era and jQuery dependencies, split page-specific CSS, and ship only code used by this landing surface.

findings.summary: Meaningful images and image links lack accessible alternatives.
findings.evidence: The images audit finds five missing alt attributes; the focus probe shows the primary CTA and logo links have empty accessible text.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful images concise alt text and every image link an accessible name; use empty alt only for decoration.

findings.summary: Orange instructional text fails WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured #ff6633 on #def2cc at 2.45:1, below the 4.5:1 minimum for 16px normal text.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose a darker foreground or lighter background that reaches at least 4.5:1.

findings.summary: The document has no heading hierarchy or main landmark.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found zero h1–h6 elements and only header/footer landmarks; Lighthouse flags the missing main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap core content in <main>, add a descriptive h1, and structure sections with semantic headings.

findings.summary: Text becomes too small to read comfortably on narrow screens.
findings.evidence: The 980px desktop layout is scaled to 36.7% in the 360px capture, shrinking instructional and footer text to a few device pixels.
findings.suggestedFix: Use responsive typography and line layout without whole-page scaling; keep body text at a readable computed size.

findings.summary: The mobile variant prevents user zoom.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse finds viewport content with user-scalable=no/maximum-scale=1, while the alternate desktop response omits viewport metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and remove user-scalable=no and restrictive maximum-scale values.

findings.summary: Image assets omit dimensions and use legacy delivery patterns.
findings.evidence: Seven of 11 images lack complete width/height, five lack responsive sources, and all 11 are GIFs.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, responsive srcset/sizes, and modern AVIF/WebP assets where animation is not required.

findings.summary: The page ships obsolete SWF-era code and jQuery 1.7.
findings.evidence: HAR records common_swf_disable.js, swf2.js, swine2.min.js, and jquery-1.7.min.js as parser-inserted scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove Flash compatibility code and migrate remaining behavior to current platform APIs without the obsolete jQuery runtime.

findings.summary: The page has no meta description and its title is minimally descriptive.
findings.evidence: The probe reports title “ﾛｸﾞｲﾝ | mogg” and description=null; Lighthouse fails meta-description.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise Japanese description and a descriptive, Unicode page title that reflects the game and login purpose.

findings.summary: Crawler and mobile signals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: robots.txt returns 404, the desktop response lacks viewport metadata, and Lighthouse finds a javascript:void(0) link.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish robots.txt, use a valid scalable viewport, and replace JavaScript pseudo-links with buttons or real hrefs.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are missing or inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The page has no canonical URL; robots.txt and sitemap.xml both return 404 while the page declares index,follow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a canonical URL and publish consistent robots.txt and sitemap.xml resources for public pages.

findings.summary: The public game landing page has no structured or social-share metadata.
findings.evidence: The probe found no JSON-LD and no Open Graph properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite or VideoGame JSON-LD and Open Graph metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: Transport defenses and cookie attributes are incomplete.
findings.evidence: CSP, HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options are missing; both first-party cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS, a restrictive CSP and nosniff; mark HTTPS cookies Secure and choose Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: The only visible authentication entry fails before exposing a usable sign-in method.
findings.evidence: The primary /my/index route returns to the same login landing with no authentication form, passkey option, explanation, or recovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a functioning Ameba authentication route, offer passkey/WebAuthn where the account system supports it, and request permissions only after user intent.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Header inspection finds no clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS, or CSP frame-ancestors.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options fallback), strict Referrer-Policy, a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, HSTS, and CSP.

findings.summary: A non-browser crawler is blocked before core content can be retrieved.
findings.evidence: The discoverability raw fetch failed and the JavaScript-disabled crawler screenshot is a CloudFront 403, while the browser-rendered view succeeds.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow legitimate non-JavaScript clients to retrieve the server-rendered landing content and test bot/CDN rules against representative crawlers.

findings.summary: This game surface has no installability or offline fallback metadata.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe finds no web app manifest; no service-worker-backed fallback is exposed by the page.
findings.suggestedFix: For this app-like game, add a manifest and service worker with a clear offline fallback and retry path.

findings.summary: Decorative assets are delivered only as legacy GIFs without responsive selection.
findings.evidence: All 11 images are GIF; five lack srcset and seven lack complete dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Convert static decoration to AVIF/WebP, provide responsive candidates, and retain GIF only where animation is essential.
